abs.name: Abs
abs.says: Distance from zero. Turns a difference into a gap.

address.name: Address
address.says: Look a machine's name up and answer its number. Unknown gives "".

age.name: Age
age.says: Days since it was last changed. A missing one is very old.

among.name: Among
among.says: True when the signal is one of a stashed collection.

ask.name: Ask
ask.says: Ask the person something and hand on what they typed.

ball.name: Ball
ball.says: Points spread over the surface of a ball.

banner.name: Banner
banner.says: Write into the strip across the top. A list becomes one line each.

bearing.name: Bearing
bearing.says: Angle from where you look to where the target is. 0 is dead ahead.

bias.name: Bias
bias.says: Add a constant to the number.

box.name: Box
box.says: The twelve edges of a box, as points.

button.more:
`button 3 "find files"` -- and `button 3 "" on=true` fills it in, so a
square can show something being on as well as being pressable.
button.name: Button
button.says: Draw one square, with words in it.

chain.name: Chain
chain.says: Parts in series. Each one's answer feeds the next.

clamp.more:
Given them the wrong way round -- `clamp 10 0` for "between 0 and 10"
-- it swaps them, rather than silently answering 10 to everything.
clamp.name: Clamp
clamp.says: Hold the number between two limits.

const.name: Const
const.says: A fixed value. Works for numbers, text, paths, lists.

contains.more:
`text` may be a literal, or another part -- `Contains(Var("name"))`
tests against whatever was stashed under that name earlier in the run.
contains.name: Contains
contains.says: True when the text is in the value. Case-insensitive by default.

copy.name: Copy
copy.says: Copy whatever comes down the chain into a folder, originals intact.

count.name: Count
count.says: How many things are in the list.

dark.name: Dark
dark.says: The other way round: on when the number is UNDER the line.

delay.more:
Until it has seen n things it hands on None, which every Number block
passes through untouched.
delay.name: Delay
delay.says: What came in n steps ago. Reaction time.

derive.name: Derive
derive.says: How fast the number is changing. Distance becomes speed.

die.name: Die
die.says: Remove the body the moment the signal goes up.

do.name: Do
do.says: Escape hatch: call your own function with the value.

dot.name: Dot
dot.says: One point in space. The start of a shape.

download.more: Passes the saved paths on, so you can chain straight into Say or Move.
download.name: Download
download.says: Pull whatever URLs come down the chain into a folder.

drain.name: Drain
drain.says: Spend a named number over time. Fuel, charge, health.

draw.more:
Each pixel is drawn two characters wide, because a character is
taller than it is wide -- two of them side by side come out square.
draw.name: Draw

drop.name: Drop
drop.says: The opposite of Keep -- throw away the items that match.

each.name: Each
each.says: Apply a part to every item of an incoming list. Returns a new list.

exists.name: Exists
exists.says: Is there anything at this path -- a file or a folder?

expire.name: Expire
expire.says: Die once the signal has been up for `after` seconds.

ext.name: Ext
ext.says: With no setting: the extension. With one: true when it matches.

fan.name: Fan
fan.says: Run several chains on the same input, then combine.

fetch.name: Fetch
fetch.says: The text at a web address. Anything that goes wrong gives "".

field.name: Field
field.says: Pull one named field out of a dict (or attribute off an object).

fill.name: Fill
fill.says: Every pixel at once, on or off, from one number.

first.more: An empty list answers None, the same as Last does.
first.name: First
first.says: The first thing in the list, or the first few.

flat.more:
`near` decides how much closer things look bigger. Set it to 0 for a
flat, engineering-drawing look with no perspective at all.
flat.name: Flat
flat.says: Drop the shape from XYZ onto the grid: 3D becomes 2D.

flatten.name: Flatten
flatten.says: A list of lists becomes one list.

forget.name: Forget
forget.says: Throw the rows away and start the table again.

gain.name: Gain
gain.says: Multiply the number. The volume knob of the language.

gate.name: Gate
gate.says: Pass the signal through only while `control` is truthy, else None.

glob.name: Glob
glob.says: Files underneath a folder whose NAME matches a pattern: *.pdf, note*

grab.name: Grab
grab.says: Pull every regex match out of the value. Text -> list.

grow.name: Grow
grow.says: Make it bigger or smaller. The scaling matrix.

have.name: Have
have.says: Is this program installed and runnable? `have git`

heading.name: Heading
heading.says: Which way it is facing, as an angle.

height.name: Height
height.says: How high above the ground this body is.

here.name: Here
here.says: The folder the program is running in.

host.name: Host
host.says: Pull the machine's name out of a web address.

integrate.name: Integrate
integrate.says: Add the number up over time. Speed becomes distance.

invert.name: Invert
invert.says: Flip the sign: 3 becomes -3, and -3 becomes 3.

is.name: Is
is.says: True when the signal equals this. Literal or another part.

isfile.name: IsFile
isfile.says: Is this path a file, rather than a folder?

json.name: Json
json.says: Parse the signal as JSON. Bad JSON gives None.

keep.name: Keep
keep.says: Keep only the items for which `test` comes back truthy.

kind.name: Kind
kind.says: What sort of machine is this -- aarch64, armv7l, x86_64, AMD64.

last.name: Last
last.says: The last thing in the list, or the last few.

level.name: Level
level.says: Read a named number off the body -- fuel, hp, ammo.

lift.name: Lift
lift.says: Push it straight up, whatever way it is facing.

light.name: Light
light.says: Turn one pixel on when the number is over the line, off when under.

lines.name: Lines
lines.says: The lines of a file, as a list.

links.more: Pass the page's own address as `base` to turn relative links absolute.
links.name: Links
links.says: Every href and src in a page of HTML. Text -> list of URLs.

lit.name: Lit
lit.says: Is that pixel on? A source, for asking the grid questions.

lower.name: Lower
lower.says: Make every letter small. HELLO becomes hello.

ls.name: Ls
ls.says: Everything directly inside a folder. One level, no recursion.

make.more:
MakeDir is the folder version. Named Make and not Touch, because
space.Touch already means "is something overlapping me".
make.name: Make
make.says: Create an empty file, or mark an existing one as changed now.

makedir.name: MakeDir
makedir.says: Create a folder, and any folders above it that it needs.

match.more: `pattern` may be a literal or another part, same as Contains.
match.name: Match
match.says: True when the value matches this regular expression.

meter.name: Meter
meter.says: A row of pixels that fills up as the number grows.

mine.name: Mine
mine.says: This machine's own name and address on the network.

minus.name: Minus
minus.says: Subtract. `other` may be a literal or another part.

missing.name: Missing
missing.says: The names of the rows that said no. Nothing missing is an empty list.

move.name: Move
move.says: Move whatever comes down the chain into a folder, leaving nothing.

name.name: Name
name.says: Just the file's own name, with no folders in front of it.

near.name: Near
near.says: Distance to the nearest other body in range, else `miss`.

open.more:
`open panel/panel.html` puts the browser panel on the screen. On a
phone it hands the job to Android.
open.name: Open
open.says: Open a file or an address with whatever usually opens it.

osc.name: Osc
osc.says: A wave over time. Needs a world for its clock.

pack.more:
Fan combines its branches into one answer; Pack keeps them apart under
names, so later blocks can pick with Field.

Pack({"name": Name(), "text": Read(), "size": Size()})
pack.name: Pack
pack.says: Run several parts on the same input and collect them into a record.

pad.more:
`pad` alone gives two across and four down, with a strip one square
tall joined across the top -- eight buttons, which is the most a
menu here ever shows.
pad.name: Pad
pad.says: Lay the window out in squares and clear it.

parent.name: Parent
parent.says: The folder a path sits in.

pick.more:
pick "install git" "install curl" "do both"

Hands on the words you picked, or None for back. The same rule the
menus and the pad keep, as a block you can put in a program.
pick.name: Pick
pick.says: Eight choices at most, the last always back, pick one by number.

pid.name: PID
pid.says: Steer the number toward zero. The whole of control, in one block.

plot.name: Plot
plot.says: Light every pixel the flattened points land on.

press.more: A typed digit counts too, so it still works where touch does not.
press.name: Press
press.says: Wait for a square to be pressed. Answers its number, or None.

put.more:
With no value it saves whatever is coming down the chain; with one it
saves that instead, so `put hot 0.8` sets a variable outright.
put.name: Put
put.says: Save a value into the run's scratch space under a name.

ray.name: Ray
ray.says: Distance to the first solid thing straight ahead. The rangefinder.

reach.name: Reach
reach.says: Can this machine be reached at all? Works on bare names too.

read.name: Read
read.says: The text inside a file. Unreadable or binary gives "".

remove.more:
Files go quietly. A FOLDER is only removed when you pass
folders=true, because deleting a tree by accident is the one mistake
you cannot undo.
remove.name: Remove

rename.name: Rename
rename.says: Rename in place. The new name may use {name}, {ext} and {n}.

replace.name: Replace
replace.says: Swap one piece of text for another, everywhere it appears.

row.more:
have git
row "git"

True becomes `ok`, false becomes `--`. The answer carries on, so a
row never gets in the way of what follows.
row.name: Row
row.says: Remember what came in as a row of a table, under this name.

run.more:
run pkg install git -y

The command is printed before it runs, so nothing happens unseen.
`run quiet=true` keeps the output to itself; otherwise you watch it
as it goes. Whether it worked is remembered for `worked`.
run.name: Run
run.says: Run a command and hand on what it said.

say.name: Say
say.says: Print it. The debugger of this language.

screen.name: Screen
screen.says: Make the grid. `screen 16 16`, or `screen fit` for the whole window.

send.name: Send
send.says: POST the signal to a URL. Returns what comes back, as text.

shared.name: Shared
shared.says: True when the signal has `least` items in common with a stashed list.

shift.name: Shift
shift.says: Shift the shape. The translation matrix.

size.name: Size
size.says: How many bytes a file is. A missing one is 0.

smooth.name: Smooth
smooth.says: Low-pass filter. Lets change through slowly, so jitter dies down.

sort.more:
`sort by=size` orders by a named field. Anything without that field
sorts as if it were empty, rather than stopping the program.
sort.name: Sort
sort.says: Put the list in order. `down=true` turns it around.

spawn.more:
Fires along body.forward() and inherits the shooter's velocity, so a
shot from something moving leads correctly without extra work.
spawn.name: Spawn
spawn.says: Emit a new body while the signal is up. The gun.

speed.name: Speed
speed.says: How fast it is going, whichever way it is going.

spin.more:
This is the rotation matrix, written out. Spins add up, so `spin y 40`
then `spin x 20` leans it over after turning it.

`spin y var=angle` takes the angle from a variable instead, so a
`tick angle by=10` earlier in the program makes it turn by itself.
spin.name: Spin
spin.says: Turn the shape around an axis. `spin y 40` is forty degrees.

spot.more:
Put it straight after `tap` and touching the screen paints on it.
`spot on=false` rubs out instead.
spot.name: Spot
spot.says: Light the pixel the signal names -- {"x": .., "y": ..} or (x, y).

status.name: Status
status.says: The number a web address answers with. 0 means it was not reached.

stop.name: Stop
stop.says: Give up here, quietly, when what came in is true.

store.name: Store
store.says: Write the number into a named slot on the body.

strip.name: Strip
strip.says: Trim the blank space off both ends of some text.

sure.name: Sure
sure.says: Ask a yes-or-no question. Anything but yes counts as no.

table.name: Table
table.says: Show every row gathered so far, and hand on the ones that failed.

tap.more:
Needs a real terminal. Anywhere else -- a pipe, a test -- it answers
None straight away rather than hanging.
tap.name: Tap
tap.says: Wait for a touch and answer with the pixel touched: {"x":.., "y":..}.

text.name: Text
text.says: Render the value into a template. {} is the value itself.

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.says: Above the line or not. Turns a measurement into a yes or no.

thrust.name: Thrust
thrust.says: Push along the way the body faces. The engine.

tick.more:
The way a program makes something move: `tick angle by=10` adds ten
to `angle` every pass, and anything reading `angle` follows along.
tick.name: Tick
tick.says: Count up in a named variable, a step each time this is reached.

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.says: Point its nose up or down.

touch.name: Touch
touch.says: 1.0 if something is overlapping this body.

try.name: Try
try.says: Run a part; if it raises, return `otherwise` instead of crashing.

turn.name: Turn
turn.says: Set how fast it swings left or right. The rudder.

uniq.name: Uniq
uniq.says: Throw away anything that appears more than once.

upper.name: Upper
upper.says: Make every letter big. hello becomes HELLO.

urls.name: Urls
urls.says: Every web address and absolute path in a piece of text, as a set.

var.name: Var
var.says: Read a named value out of the run's scratch space.

walk.more: skip: folder names never descended into.
walk.name: Walk
walk.says: Every file underneath a folder, all the way down.

wipe.name: Wipe
wipe.says: Blank the whole terminal. Use once before a moving picture.

words.name: Words
words.says: The uncommon words in a piece of text, as a set.

worked.name: Worked
worked.says: Did the last `run` work? Nothing run yet counts as no.

write.name: Write
write.says: Write the signal into a file. Creates parent folders.
